confidence_notes: Recent Amritsar crowd data has only 21 contributors; restaurant and coffee anchors are better grounded than drinks or lodging. Cocktail uses a current local cost listing, wine per glass is inferred from local bottle-wine and draft-beer prices, and accommodation is a holistic estimate.
comparable_city_reasoning: For lodging, use budget and three-star ranges typical of North Indian pilgrimage and domestic-tourism cities such as Agra and Varanasi; food prices use Amritsar-specific recent crowd-reported averages.
